 The U! Brysen Wright makes college decision official, chooses Hurricanes
 Justin Barney , News4JAX sports editor
 Published:  November 5, 2026 at 1:34 PM Tags:  High School , Varsity 4 , Sports4JAX , Football Friday Mandarin's Brysen Wright heads to the end zone during Friday's 14-7 win over Bradford. (Ralph D. Priddy, News4JAX) JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – Mandarin athlete Brysen Wright has made his college decision official.
 In front of a packed auditorium on Thursday afternoon, the junior five-star committed to the University of Miami. The verbal commitment is non-binding and won’t tie him to the Hurricanes until he’s able to sign a national letter of intent. Players in the Class of 2027 can sign from Dec. 2-4. Wright will reclassify as part of his commitment. 
 Recommended Videos
 Wright, 16, is a 6-4, 205-pound junior. He’s one of the most visible and recognized athletes in the modern era, thanks in part to a robust social media presence, and viral highlights at both the flag and 7-on level. Wright has been truly the area’s first NIL superstar. He was the first known local player to sign an NIL deal with a sports card company last year (he signed a five-figure deal with Wild Card) and wound up having a signature cleat released by Battle Sports last August. 
 Wright’s commitment takes the suspense out of the biggest blue chip locally on the recruiting board. He’s been a known player since his middle school days in St. Johns County and has only amplified that throughout his three seasons of varsity football. Wright is one of the most well-known and hyped recruits in area history. He reached five-star status early in his career and could finish as one of the top-ranked local recruits in the modern era of recruiting by the time final rankings are 
 Wright helped lead Mandarin to back-to-back 9-1 regular seasons. 
 He’s up to 984 yards receiving and 11 touchdowns on 46 catches this year, all career highs. Wright has also shined on defense and special teams. He’s picked off seven passes as a safety and made 81 tackles. Wright has five touchdowns on defense and special teams.
